The '''Golden Galley''' was a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] that, according to a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who served behind a desk at [[Reaver Station]], had great [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] at good prices. During a [[mission to Reaver Station]], [[Theron Shan]] pretended that he had just arrived at the station as part of a supply run and asked the women if she knew a place to get something to eat, the women responded that she would usually suggest the Golden Galley before adding that Shan should not visit it on that particular [[Standard day/Legends|day]] as a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] had arrived earlier and hit the restaurant like a swarm of [[fefze]].<ref name="Annihilation" />
